diagnosis.verdict: No hop upstream of kafka-1b5cb1e7.webshop.public.products explains it. Checked 3 hops upstream across 3 services. 1 of them could not be assessed at all (webshop-simulator), so this is "nothing found" rather than "nothing wrong". Look at whatever reads this, or at the query producing the symptom.
diagnosis.freshness: No hop in this chain measures its own delay, so there is no end-to-end figure. Consumer lag is the only latency this project captures, and there is no Kafka hop here to read it from.
diagnosis.boundary: The walk stops where Aiven can see: the last hop inside the platform. Whatever reads the end of this chain — a dashboard, a job, somebody's notebook — is invisible here, and is where a symptom nothing upstream explains usually turns out to live.

policy.because: Three brokers make a rolling restart survivable, but lowering retention deletes records a lagging consumer has not read yet, and no amount of purpose makes that recoverable.
policy.basis: written for this service, overriding what its criticality would give it
